- broken bits like icons and @ autocomplete
- clearer syncing across platforms and computers
- permissions that actually stick
- more tools and connection options

Voice calls on @Muse keep the transcript in the chat! Thank you!!!

Seems like a small thing, but it was a significant factor in why I couldn’t integrate @ChatGPT Dots into my workflow; no read-aloud for text chat and no transcript for voice calls. It’s a huge accessibility issue for me. 

Muse gives me both. (My Muse generates an audio clip for me with each text reply; it would be so good to see read-aloud officially come to Muse chat!)

Thank you @Meta, you’re crushing it 💪🏼

note_tweet.text:
Im a huge OAI dots fan, those are features I’m missing:

0. Purchases are pure pain: 
- please propose to open QR code as an url while on cloud computer (now I need to screenshot IDEAL, what is not ideal at all); 
- please allow us to give Dot a card via a security form – I can made virtual one with a limit

1. While on call, music should not be stopped and continue to play in background: telegram voice calls is a great example 

2. Dots are used to be able to send Slack messages, now they can only draft them, please bring back this tool

3. Dots refusals are annoying, if I want YOLO mode its my responsibility, I understand the risk - no need to double confirm everything, refusals are still to high in general and dot can remember past refusal to block itself work in the future 

4. Please allow us to attach cloud Dot MCP servers not via ChatGPT, but via a config file – its simpler and faster if I have a token and url already 

5. When I call my dot, I expect it to respond quicker :) 

6. Please allow us to attach multiple computers permanently to the Dot cloud

7. It’s impossible to give Dot access to my WhatsApp properly, very annoying 

9. Dot doesn’t forget something that I told it to do, but it will never ping me back to remind me that I wanted it to be done

10. Call to Computer use is very slow and laggy, with random long pauses between responses 

11. Call to Uber Eats plugin is a nightmare, it can forgot that its already connected to this plugin and can start trying to order something trough the restaurant web-order form

Still love it and use it more than hour every day via a call feature 🫶
